Name: Learn Chinese Through Stardew Valley
Author: chikenzhou
Description:
[size=5]Learn Chinese Through Stardew Valley[/size]

[size=4]About This Mod[/size]
This is an all-in-one SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6+ that brings native Simplified Chinese, character-top [b]Pinyin (拼音)[/b] annotations, [b]English[/b] translations, and an interactive [b]in-game Chinese Lexicon & Mastery Tracker[/b] together in one seamless experience.

Whether you are [b]studying Mandarin Chinese through gameplay immersion[/b] or playing Co-op / Split-Screen together as a Chinese-native and English-native speaker, this mod ensures every dialogue box, item tooltip, quest log, mail letter, event cutscene, festival, TV channel, and menu is readable by everyone at the same time.
[line]
[size=4]Key Features[/size]
- [b]Bilingual Everywhere (中文 + Pinyin / English)[/b]: Displays Simplified Chinese with tone-marked Pinyin directly above every Chinese character alongside the official English text.

[b]- In-Game Valley Lexicon & HSK 1–6 Mastery Tracker[/b]: Open the pause menu (Esc or E) and click the [b]Dictionary Tab[/b] (red book icon with a gold star) to browse [b]14,970+ atomic Chinese words & characters[/b] covering all of Stardew Valley and official HSK 1–6:
[list]
[*][b]Sorted by Real-World Mandarin Frequency[/b]: Every category ([i]HSK & Everyday[/i], [i]Crops & Food[/i], [i]Tools & Craft[/i], [i]Fish & Ranch[/i], [i]Town & Villagers[/i]) is ordered from most frequent in modern Mandarin usage to least frequent.[/*]
[*][b]Progressive Pinyin Hiding[/b]: Click any word card to mark it [b]Known[/b] (or right-click for [b]Mastered[/b])—or click [b]Mark Page Known[/b]—to automatically hide Pinyin above that specific word everywhere in the game while keeping Pinyin above words you are still learning![/*]
[*][b]Official HSK 1–6 Baselines[/b]: Optionally cycle the [b]Base HSK (2.0) Level[/b] button between [b]Off[/b] (default), [b]HSK 1[/b] (150 words), [b]HSK 2[/b] (300 words), [b]HSK 3[/b] (600 words), [b]HSK 4[/b] (1,200 words), [b]HSK 5[/b] (2,500 words), and [b]HSK 6[/b] (5,000 words) to immediately match your current Mandarin proficiency.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Trilingual Search[/b]: Search by English meaning, tone-free Pinyin (shui, shuiguo), or Chinese characters (水果) at any time.[/*]
[/list]-[b] Instant Mode Switching (F2)[/b]: Press a single key at any time, even mid-conversation, inside your inventory, or while reading mail to cycle between:
  1. [b]Bilingual Mode[/b] (中文 + Pinyin and English)
  2. [b]Chinese + Pinyin Only[/b]
  3.[b] English Only[/b]
- [b]Instant Pinyin Toggle (F3)[/b]: Turn Pinyin annotations above Chinese characters on or off on the fly as your reading confidence grows.
[b]- 4 Selectable Chinese Font Styles[/b]: Choose between [b]Bold Hanzi[/b] (default), [b]Regular[/b], [b]Noto Sans Bold[/b] (swaps the Chinese character body with [i]Noto Sans CJK SC Bold[/i] while keeping crisp Pinyin on top), and [b]Extra Bold Hanzi[/b]—with zero-lag instant switching via pre-baked font atlases.
[line]
[size=4]Pre-Requisites[/size]
1. Stardew Valley 1.6+
2. [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/url] (version 4.0.0 or newer)
3. (Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - Allows you to customize all keybinds, default display mode, font sizes, and horizontal/vertical line spacing directly from the Configure Mods gear icon on the title screen or the bottom of the in-game Options tab.
[line]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download and extract this mod so that the [b]BilingualPinyinMod[/b] folder is placed directly inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods [/b]directory:
  [i]- Default Steam Path: [/i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\BilingualPinyinMod
3. Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b].
4. Language Note: The mod[b] automatically switches the game's base language[/b] to [b]Simplified Chinese (`简体中文`) [/b]on launch so that all Pinyin fonts and bilingual strings work out of the box. You do not need to manually change the language in the title menu.
[line]
[size=4]Default Controls & Customization[/size]
[list=1]
[*]F2: Cycle Display Mode - Alternate between Bilingual, Chinese Only, and English Only[/*]
[*]F3: Toggle Pinyin On/Off - Instantly turn Pinyin annotations on or off[/*]
[*]Menu[b] → Dictionary Tab - [/b] Opens the Valley Lexicon to search words, set your Base HSK Level (1–6), or mark words as Known / Mastered to hide their Pinyin in-game. [/*]
[/list]All keybinds, font styles, font sizes, horizontal Pinyin spacing, and vertical line spacing can be customized either via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] ("Configure Mods") or by editing config.json inside the Mods/BilingualPinyinMod folder.
[line]
[size=4]Limitations[/size]
- [b]Base Game Text Only (Currently)[/b]: Right now, this mod only supports [b]vanilla (base game) Stardew Valle* text and assets[/b]. Custom text added by other expansion or content mods (such as Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, etc.) is not yet paired into the bilingual database—[b]though if there is demand from the community, I can add support for popular mods in future updates![/b]
- [b]Language Setting[/b]: Keep the in-game language set to [b]Simplified Chinese (简体中文)[/b] (which the mod sets automatically on launch). If you want to play in pure English temporarily, use the F2 or F4 hotkey rather than changing the language button on the title screen.
[line]

Downloads.Description:
This zip file contains the following:
- BilingualPinyinMod.dll & manifest.json: Core mod
- assets/bilingual-pack.bin: CN/EN bilingual game text data
- assets/lexicon-pack.bin: Valley Lexicon dictionary & HSK 1–6 vocabulary data
- assets/fonts/: Fonts used
